title: Configurable runner models and structured catalogs
description: Proves the gateway reports a structured runner model catalog, keeps an explicit model when it is outside the saved visible set, leaves stored runs unchanged, reports the shared picker defaults before a save, keeps the native default selectable, and that Command Center loads saved defaults on direct Evals entry, saves visible defaults, offers only accepted efforts for a catalog-only model, and drops a stale catalog response.

catalog-codex.cmd: env -u FARMSLOT_GATEWAY_TOKEN -u FARMSLOT_GATEWAY_PASSWORD -u FARMSLOT_ROOT FARMSLOT_GATEWAY=ws://127.0.0.1:8808 node apps/command-center/scripts/cdp.mjs gateway runner.modelCatalog '{"runner":"codex"}'
catalog-codex.intent: Read the Codex model catalog through the sandbox gateway.

assert-codex-catalog.intent: The Codex catalog is ready from its structured file.

assert-codex-model.intent: The catalog includes the runner-reported Astra model.

assert-codex-reasoning.intent: Astra's structured reasoning modes include ultra.

assert-codex-source.intent: The catalog came from a structured file, not runner text.

catalog-claude.cmd: env -u FARMSLOT_GATEWAY_TOKEN -u FARMSLOT_GATEWAY_PASSWORD -u FARMSLOT_ROOT FARMSLOT_GATEWAY=ws://127.0.0.1:8808 node apps/command-center/scripts/cdp.mjs gateway runner.modelCatalog '{"runner":"claude"}'
catalog-claude.intent: Ask for a catalog from a runner that does not declare one.

assert-claude-unsupported.intent: Claude is reported unsupported instead of a guessed model list.

catalog-pi-unavailable.cmd: set -euo pipefail; src="$HOME/.pi/agent/models-store.json"; bak="$(mktemp)"; cp "$src" "$bak"; restore() { cp "$bak" "$src"; rm -f "$bak"; }; trap restore EXIT; rm "$src"; env -u FARMSLOT_GATEWAY_TOKEN -u FARMSLOT_GATEWAY_PASSWORD -u FARMSLOT_ROOT FARMSLOT_GATEWAY=ws://127.0.0.1:8808 node apps/command-center/scripts/cdp.mjs gateway runner.modelCatalog '{"runner":"pi"}'
catalog-pi-unavailable.intent: Hide the Pi structured catalog for one read and ask the gateway again.

assert-pi-unavailable.intent: A missing structured catalog is unavailable and is not replaced from runner text.

snapshot-runs.cmd: env -u FARMSLOT_GATEWAY_TOKEN -u FARMSLOT_GATEWAY_PASSWORD -u FARMSLOT_ROOT FARMSLOT_GATEWAY=ws://127.0.0.1:8808 node apps/command-center/scripts/cdp.mjs gateway run.list '{"limit":20}' > /tmp/manual-000131-runs-before.json && wc -c < /tmp/manual-000131-runs-before.json
snapshot-runs.intent: Record the sandbox run list before changing visible models.

set-visible-codex.cmd: env -u FARMSLOT_GATEWAY_TOKEN -u FARMSLOT_GATEWAY_PASSWORD -u FARMSLOT_ROOT FARMSLOT_GATEWAY=ws://127.0.0.1:8808 node apps/command-center/scripts/cdp.mjs gateway runner.visibleModels.set '{"runner":"codex","models":["gpt-5.4"]}'
set-visible-codex.intent: Save a Codex visible-default list that omits the current Astra selection.

assert-visible-saved.intent: The gateway stored the operator's visible defaults.

read-retained-choice.cmd: env -u FARMSLOT_GATEWAY_TOKEN -u FARMSLOT_GATEWAY_PASSWORD -u FARMSLOT_ROOT FARMSLOT_GATEWAY=ws://127.0.0.1:8808 node apps/command-center/scripts/cdp.mjs gateway runner.visibleModels.get '{"runner":"codex","selectedModel":"gpt-6-astra"}'
read-retained-choice.intent: Read the visible set while an older Astra selection is still explicit.

assert-retained-model.intent: The explicit Astra selection stays valid outside the saved visible set.

compare-runs.cmd: env -u FARMSLOT_GATEWAY_TOKEN -u FARMSLOT_GATEWAY_PASSWORD -u FARMSLOT_ROOT FARMSLOT_GATEWAY=ws://127.0.0.1:8808 node apps/command-center/scripts/cdp.mjs gateway run.list '{"limit":20}' > /tmp/manual-000131-runs-after.json && cmp /tmp/manual-000131-runs-before.json /tmp/manual-000131-runs-after.json && echo RUNS_UNCHANGED
compare-runs.intent: Read the run list again after the visible-model write.

assert-runs-unchanged.intent: Stored runs still have the same payload, including any historical model.

read-seed-pi.cmd: env -u FARMSLOT_GATEWAY_TOKEN -u FARMSLOT_GATEWAY_PASSWORD -u FARMSLOT_ROOT FARMSLOT_GATEWAY=ws://127.0.0.1:8808 node apps/command-center/scripts/cdp.mjs gateway runner.visibleModels.get '{"runner":"pi"}'
read-seed-pi.intent: Read Pi's visible models before any Pi set is saved.

assert-seed-pi-unsaved.intent: Pi has no saved visible set on this gateway.

assert-seed-pi-anthropic.intent: Unsaved Pi keeps the picker's Anthropic models.

read-seed-cursor.cmd: env -u FARMSLOT_GATEWAY_TOKEN -u FARMSLOT_GATEWAY_PASSWORD -u FARMSLOT_ROOT FARMSLOT_GATEWAY=ws://127.0.0.1:8808 node apps/command-center/scripts/cdp.mjs gateway runner.visibleModels.get '{"runner":"cursor"}'
read-seed-cursor.intent: Read Cursor's visible models before any Cursor set is saved.

assert-seed-cursor.intent: Unsaved Cursor keeps the picker models the native list lacks.

read-native-catalog.cmd: env -u FARMSLOT_GATEWAY_TOKEN -u FARMSLOT_GATEWAY_PASSWORD -u FARMSLOT_ROOT FARMSLOT_GATEWAY=ws://127.0.0.1:8808 node apps/command-center/scripts/cdp.mjs gateway native.session.catalog '{}' | node -e 'let s="";process.stdin.on("data",(d)=>(s+=d)).on("end",()=>{const c=JSON.parse(s).runners.find((r)=>r.runner==="codex");console.log(c.models.includes(c.defaultModel)?"NATIVE_DEFAULT_SELECTABLE "+c.defaultModel+" in "+c.models.join(","):"NATIVE_DEFAULT_MISSING "+c.defaultModel+" not in "+c.models.join(","))})'
read-native-catalog.intent: Read the native session catalog while Codex visibility omits its default model.

assert-native-default.intent: A new native Codex session's default model is still in its picker.
